hook.name: DynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Immutable hook that applies monotonic time-decaying LP fees: starts at 1% for the first 7 days after pool launch, drops to 0.5% between days 7–15, and settles at 0.3% thereafter. Pool initialization is restricted to a designated position manager and requires currency0 to implement a launcher interface pointing to an authorized launch authority.
